wiki.title: Cindi Duchow
wiki.extract: Cindi Duchow (born August 21, 1959) is an American retail manager and Republican politician from Waukesha County, Wisconsin. She is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 97th Assembly district since 2025; she previously represented the 99th Assembly district from 2015 to 2025. Earlier in her career, she served on the town board of Delafield, Wisconsin.
